{"id":1932690715,"question_id":3938,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1772188461,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1932690715/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Twisted Mirror Path Count","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int paths = 0;\n    const int mod = 1e9+7;\n\n    bool isValid(vector<vector<int>>& grid , int &x , int &y , bool &isright)\n    {\n        int n = grid.size();\n        int m = grid[0].size();\n        \n        while(x >= 0 and x < n and y >= 0 and y < m and grid[x][y] == 1)\n        {\n            //found a mirror\n            if(isright)\n            {\n                x = x+1;\n                isright = false;\n            }\n            else \n            {\n                y = y+1;\n                isright = true;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if(x >= 0 and x < n and y >= 0 and y < m) return true;\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    void solve(vector<vector<int>>& grid , int i , int j)\n    {\n        int n = grid.size();\n        int m = grid[0].size();\n\n        if(i < 0 or i >= n or j < 0 or j >= m) return;\n\n        if(i == n-1 and j == m-1)\n        {\n            paths = (paths + 1) % mod;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        //going right\n        if(j+1 < m)\n        {\n            bool isright = true;\n            int x = i;\n            int y = j+1;\n\n            if(isValid(grid , x , y , isright)) solve(grid , x,  y);\n        }\n        \n        //going down\n        if(i+1 < n)\n        {\n            bool isright = false;\n            int x = i+1;\n            int y = j;\n\n            if(isValid(grid , x , y , isright)) solve(grid , x,  y);\n        }\n    }\n\n    int uniquePaths(vector<vector<int>>& grid) {\n        solve(grid , 0 , 0);\n        return paths;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"twisted-mirror-path-count","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1746}
